source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Protocols and Services' (PDF 14): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network protocol communication (baat-cheet) ke rules (qaidon) ka set hai. Yeh tay karta hai ke data kis format (shakal) mein aur kaise transmit (bheja) hota hai. Protocols error handling (ghalti sambhalna) aur data delivery control karte hain. Network ke tamam devices ko ek hi protocol follow karna (maanna) zaroori hai. Protocols data exchange (len-den) ko smooth (baghair rukawat) banate hain. Misaalein: TCP/IP aur HTTP.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Protocols un zabanon ki tarah hain jin mein computers aapas mein baat karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Network ke saare devices ko ek hi protocol kyun maanna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke protocol baat-cheet ki zaban hai; agar har device alag qaide maane to woh ek doosre ka data samajh nahi sakenge.

items: Protocol: data ke format, bhejne, error handling aur delivery ke qaide; sab devices ek hi protocol maanein.
